Name: TV Announcements
Author: zyin
Description:
Displays a notification when you wake up telling you what the Fortune Teller and Weather Report says, as well as if the Queen of Sauce is on today.

All 3 notifications can be configured to be turned on/off. Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (not required).


Source code: [url=https://github.com/Zyin055/TVAnnouncements]https://github.com/Zyin055/TVAnnouncements[/url]

Downloads.Description:
Updated after being dead for 3 years! Yay!
